themes.name: 水耕栽培与光照控制技术
themes.problem: To provide a cultivation method for fruit and vegetable plants that can be harvested at a higher yield than conventional methods.
themes.means: flooded hydroponic cultivation method, light source emitting artificial light, light reflection member, hydroponic shelves in two or more tiers
themes.effect: higher sugar contents, higher yield, uniform light irradiation

evidence.quote: the cultivation device being designed to cultivate fruit vegetable plants of the Solanaceae family or Cucurbitaceae family, the device comprising: a light source that emits artificial light; hydroponic shelves; and a light reflection member.
A method for cultivating fruit and vegetable plants, comprising the step of cultivating fruit and vegetable plants using a flooded hydroponic cultivation method
an apparatus for cultivating a fruiting plant, the apparatus being provided with a light source for emitting artificial light, a hydroponic cultivation mechanism for a fruiting plant

themes.name: 无法确定
themes.problem: To provide a plant-cultivating apparatus which can uniformly irradiate light on many plants in a simple structure.
themes.means: light reflection member, light-guiding films, light-focusing portions, light-introducing portions, light-outgoing portions

evidence.quote: This plant-cultivating apparatus 40 has cultivation units 30a to 30d arranged in a multistory structure, and the cultivation units have cultivation chambers 31a to 31d and light-focusing portions 21a to 21d, respectively.

Light-guiding films 10p to 10s are arranged in the cultivation units, respectively. Light-introducing portions 11 are disposed at the longitudinal one ends of the light guide films, and light-outgoing portions 12a to 12c are disposed at the other end portions.
The light source is disposed on a side of the fruit vegetable plant. The light reflection member is positioned so as to oppose the light source across the fruit vegetable plant.

themes.unverified_name: 光照反射与分布优化技术

evidence.quote: ニンジンの苗１０を、ニンジンの苗の根部１１が鉛直方向下側に配置されるように保持し、ニンジンの苗の根部と、容器１内に貯留した養液２の液面との距離を変動させながら、ニンジンの苗に人工光を照射するニンジンの栽培方法。
Sｉ含有率が６０質量ｐｐｍ以上の培養液を使用した水耕法により、果菜植物を栽培する、果菜植物の栽培方法、トマト、果菜植物水耕栽培用培養液及び果菜植物水耕栽培装置。
果菜植物を栽培する複数の栽培棚が収容される栽培空間と、各栽培棚で栽培される果菜植物に光を照射する光源と、各栽培棚への光強度を検出する光検出部と、各栽培棚の二酸化炭素濃度を検出する二酸化炭素検出部と、各栽培棚の温湿度を検出する温湿度検出部と、少なくとも、光強度、二酸化炭素濃度、及び温湿度を制御する制御部と、を備え
